pr_title: TrinoHook add authentication via JWT token and Impersonation
pr_body:
closes: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/18969
This change introduces the authentication method via JWT and also the possibility to impersonate as DAG owner.

issue_context.title: Trino JWT Authentication Support
issue_context.body:
### Description

Would be great to support JWT Authentication in Trino Hook (which also can be used for presto hook).

For example like this

```
        elif extra.get('auth') == 'jwt':
            auth = trino.auth.JWTAuthentication(
                token=extra.get('jwt__token')
            )
```
